events.title: Parks, Edward F. v. Thornell, Dir., AZ DOC, et al.
events.summary: The Supreme Court denied the motion of petitioner Edward F. Parks for leave to proceed in forma pauperis and dismissed the petition for a writ of certiorari. The Court directed the Clerk not to accept any further petitions in noncriminal matters from Parks unless the docketing fee is paid and the petition complies with Rule 33.1, citing repeated abuse of the Court's process.
events.why_relevant: This order limits the petitioner's access to the Court, reflecting the Court's stance on preventing abuse of its process.
